name: merge-records
title: Merge Records
description: Duplicate merge panel where each field defaults to the most recent non-empty value, real conflicts are marked (ignoring case and spacing), and a live readback names every value that will be discarded, which record keeps its ID and which links move to it.

meta.summary: Before merging duplicate records, names every value that will be discarded, so a merge doesn't silently throw data away.
meta.server: Run the merge in one transaction on the server and keep an audit record of discarded values.
catches: Values that the merge will discard, listed by name
Links (deals, tickets, integrations) that move to the survivor
limits: Defaults by last-updated time, which isn't always the right value
Moves and deletes are done by your onMerge
One value per field; it can't combine lists
a11y: Per-field choices and the survivor are native radio inputs in labelled groups
Readback highlight animation is skipped under reduced motion
